The upstream README says the data was crawled from the Youdao vocabulary app.
At the pinned commit, the repository has no LICENSE file and no explicit
redistribution grant was found. This notice does not grant any rights in the
source definitions, pronunciations or example sentences. No open license is
asserted. The application's source-code license does not cover these data.
The bundled copy is a local study/test dataset; public or commercial distribution
requires appropriate permission or replacement by a clearly licensed dataset.

Normalization preserves the source headwords, Chinese definitions, parts of
speech, phonetics and first available example sentence/translation. Missing
fields remain empty; no synthetic example sentences are added.

See vocabulary-provenance.json for SHA-256 checksums and exact normalization
counts, and ../docs/vocabulary.md for format and development rebuild instructions.
